title: Giant progenitor comet behind the Taurid meteor stream
summary: Randall Carlson tells of Giant progenitor comet behind the Taurid meteor stream, about 25,000-30,000 years ago at Inner solar system, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: 25 to 30,000 years ago a gigantic comet maybe 50 to 60 mi diameter nucleus or even bigger came it was captured into a a sub jovian orbit

plain: A researcher named Randall Carlson, on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that 25,000 to 30,000 years ago a gigantic comet, its core perhaps 50 to 60 miles across or more, was captured into an orbit inside Jupiter's. He draws on the work of Victor Clube, William Napier and William Asher, and presents this comet as the parent of the Taurids, a stream of meteors Earth passes through every year. If true, it would mean the debris of one huge comet still circles near our planet.
